Describe the concrete behavior or documentation improvement.

## Verification / 验证

Commands/checks and results. Distinguish simulation, synthetic audio, microphone and real-board evidence. State skips and pending checks.

## Contribution checklist / 提交检查

- [ ] English and Chinese core documents updated where relevant.
- [ ] No credentials, household information, raw audio/conversations or restricted weights included.
